items.snippet_en: DD India reported that India made history on August 23, 2023, when Chandrayaan-3 successfully achieved a soft landing near the Moon's south pole, making it the first country to do so.
NASA states that Chandrayaan-3 is an Indian Space Research Organization mission that landed near the south pole of the Moon on August 23, 2023.

Space.com reported that the Indian Space Research Organisation successfully landed its Chandrayaan-3 Vikram lander near the lunar south pole, marking its first moon landing and the first probe ever to land at the Moon's south pole.
Al Jazeera reported on August 23, 2023, that India could become the first nation to land a spacecraft on the Moon's south pole.
BBC News reported on August 23, 2023, that the Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully touched down as planned at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT).
NDTV reported on August 23, 2023, that the Vikram lander touched down at 6:04 PM on Wednesday, August 23, and ISRO celebrated the occasion with a post on X at the exact time of touchdown.
Space.com reported on August 22, 2023, that Chandrayaan-3 was expected to touch down at 8:34 a.m. EDT (1:34 p.m. GMT, or 6:04 p.m. in India).
Al Jazeera reported on August 23, 2023, that Chandrayaan-3 was scheduled to touch down shortly after 6 PM India time (12:30 GMT).
